name: EmailCheck — API on RapidAPI
description:
Clean email lists before they cost you bounces: EmailCheck returns a deliverability verdict for every address — single or in batches of up to 100 — so signup flows, CRM imports and outbound campaigns only keep addresses that are safe to mail.

What you get:
- A clear verdict per address (deliverable / risky / undeliverable) backed by a quality score, not just a true/false flag
- The full signal set behind the verdict: syntax, MX and domain checks, catch-all risk signal, and domain age from registration records
- Typo detection with a correction suggestion (e.g. gamil.com → gmail.com), so fixable addresses are recovered instead of dropped
- Batch results in the same per-address format, ready to feed back into your list-cleaning pipeline

Key endpoints:
- GET /validate — validate a single email address
- POST /validate — validate a single email address (JSON body)
- POST /validate/batch — validate up to 100 addresses in one call

Batch / built for workflows:
List cleaning is the primary use case, not an afterthought: /validate/batch accepts up to 100 addresses per request and returns one structured result per address, so scheduled hygiene jobs, import pipelines and pre-send checks can run unattended. Single-address validation uses the same response format, so your parsing code is identical either way.

Plans: Free includes 100 validations per month. PRO is $9/month for 10,000 requests. ULTRA is $29/month for higher-volume workloads.

Access: subscribe on RapidAPI (free tier available); calls are made over HTTPS with your RapidAPI key.
